intro.title: 7 layers, built for better sleep
intro.desc: From breathable comfort to pressure relief and motion isolation, each layer works harder.

layers.title: TENCEL™ Lyocell cover
layers.desc: Cool against the skin, breathable by nature, and softly smooth to the touch, this cover helps manage heat and moisture through the night.

layers.title: Cooling memory gel
layers.desc: Contours to your body to ease pressure across the shoulders, back, and hips, while gel infusion helps dissipate excess heat.

layers.title: Support memory foam
layers.desc: A responsive foam layer that adds cushioning without losing structure, helping the mattress feel balanced, supportive, and shape-retaining.

layers.title: Pocket spring
layers.desc: Individually wrapped springs help minimise motion transfer, improve airflow, and provide targeted support where your body needs it most.
